la_mirada.name: La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts
la_mirada.neighborhood: La Mirada (southeast Los Angeles County, near the 5/91 freeway junction)
la_mirada.address: 14900 La Mirada Blvd, La Mirada, CA 90638
la_mirada.what_it_is: City-owned and city-operated performing arts theatre that opened in 1977 in a converted former movie house. Each year it co-produces a Broadway Series of five professional plays and musicals with McCoy Rigby Entertainment (MRE).
facts: Opened in 1977 after the La Mirada City Council redeveloped an obsolete movie house (earlier operated by Pacific Theatres / Stanley-Warner) into a performing arts theatre; it is owned and operated by the City of La Mirada.
Seating capacity is reported inconsistently: most sources say 1,251 seats; the theatre's own technical pack dated 2026-01-08 says 1,288 seats.

The City contracted McCoy Rigby Entertainment to produce Broadway-quality shows after audiences declined; MRE now produces the annual Broadway Series of five professional plays and musicals. The 2026-27 season includes Little Shop of Horrors (season opener), Dear Evan Hansen and Les Miserables.

Parking is free in a dedicated on-site lot adjacent to the theatre, with accessible spaces near the main entrance; the lot is shared with a shopping center (Wendy's, Taco Bell) and visitor tips say it can fill up, so arrive early.

Local press reported the theatre broke box-office records for a fourth straight year in August 2025; it received a Playbill-reported Reining award. Vibe per visitor tips: suburban, family-friendly, easy-to-reach regional house rather than a downtown venue.
la_mirada.price: Face-value single-ticket prices not found online. 2026-27 subscription package pages show per-seat prices from about $108.75 (Section D orchestra / accessible and lower balcony) to $356.25 (Premiere Orchestra) for a package that includes Dear Evan Hansen; single tickets may differ. Online single-ticket fees: 10% per ticket + $0.50 per order; phone 10% per ticket; no fee at the box office window.
la_mirada.hours_note: Box office: 714-994-6310 or 562-944-9801, boxoffice@lamiradatheatre.com. Opening hours not verified.
la_mirada.age_note: Varies by show; Dear Evan Hansen is recommended for ages 13+.
la_mirada.booking_note: Book direct at lamiradatheatre.com/tickets or cart.lamiradatheatre.com; resale marketplaces (TickPick, TicketSmarter, TodayTix listings) show inflated prices and some inconsistent dates.

dear_evan_hansen.dates: October 30 - November 22, 2026 (preview Fri Oct 30 8pm; press openings Sat Oct 31 2pm and 8pm). Performances Thu 7:30pm, Fri 8pm, Sat 2pm & 8pm, Sun 1:30pm & 6:30pm. NOTE: this run ends November 22, 2026 and does NOT overlap a December 2026 / January 2027 visit; no later run was found.
dear_evan_hansen.price: Face-value single-ticket range not found. Subscription package pricing that includes this show runs roughly $108.75-$356.25 per seat. Resale sites quote an average of about $238 and listings up to $436-$552, which are secondary-market prices, not face value.
dear_evan_hansen.age_note: Recommended for ages 13 and up; contains adult language and themes of depression and suicide. Run time about 2 hours 30 minutes with one intermission.
dear_evan_hansen.production_note: Southern California regional premiere presented by La Mirada Theatre and McCoy Rigby Entertainment; directed by Stephen C. Anthony; Tyler Donovan McCall as Evan Hansen.

come_from_away.dates: October 4 - November 1, 2026 at A Noise Within, 3352 E Foothill Blvd, Pasadena, CA 91107 (Oct 4 was a preview; BroadwayWorld gives regular performances Oct 10 - Nov 1). Closing performance Sunday November 1, 2026 at 2pm.
come_from_away.status: Confirmed closing November 1, 2026. No extension or later run in December 2026 or January 2027 was found in any source; TodayTix showed it selling out through Nov 1. In-house A Noise Within production directed by Julia Rodriguez-Elliott.

music_man.venue: Ahmanson Theatre, 135 N Grand Ave, Los Angeles (Center Theatre Group) - the only Los Angeles engagement found, but it is outside the Dec 2026 / Jan 2027 window.
music_man.dates: October 27 - November 8, 2026 (Big League Productions national tour; first major LA engagement since 1980). Resale prices from about $38-$54. No Music Man production was found at the Ahmanson, Hollywood Pantages, Dolby Theatre, Segerstrom/Orange County, or elsewhere in Los Angeles for December 2026 or January 2027. The Pantages 2027 lineup found (Jersey Boys, Buena Vista Social Club, Operation Mincemeat, Hamilton) does not include it. A Playbill musician notice lists the tour running through December 27, 2026, with a later San Francisco Orpheum stop mentioned but undated. A TodayTix listing claiming the Ahmanson run ends August 11, 2027 contradicts official sources and appears to be a listing error.

groundlings.venue: The Groundlings Theatre, 7307 Melrose Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90046; box office (323) 934-4747
groundlings.schedule: Per the undated groundlings.com/shows page (treat as a snapshot; confirm on the live calendar): Thursdays 8pm 'Cookin' with GAS' (all-improv show running since 1992 with Main Company, Alumni and Sunday Company members); Fridays and Saturdays 7:30pm main-stage sketch/improv show (current title listed as 'Cirque-Du-Groundlings'); Fridays and Saturdays 9:30pm 'The Completely Different Late Show'; a Sunday sketch show (Sunday Company). Older listings also show a Wednesday 8pm 'Crazy Uncle Joe Show' improv, but no 2026 dates for it were found.
groundlings.price: No 2026 face-value prices found. Older listings: about $18 (Crazy Uncle Joe, 2018), $25 (2021) and $28 (2023) for regular shows; a New Year's Eve 2026 special event was listed at $102. Expect current regular-show prices to differ; check groundlings.com/shows.
groundlings.age_note: No general age policy found for the current schedule. One 2021 show was listed as ages 16 and over; this may not apply to other shows. Confirm per show when booking.
